```{r}
# Parameters
H <- 3  # Number of sites
m_hosp <- sample(50:75, H, replace = TRUE)  # Number of patients per site
px <- 6  # Number of covariates
p_bin <- 3  # Number of binary covariates
p_cont <- px - p_bin  # Number of continuous covariates
py <- 3 # Number of outcomes (multivariate)

# Fixed effects
beta <- matrix(runif(px*py, -3, 3), nrow = px, ncol = py)  # Fixed effects for covariates

# Variance components
sigma_u <- 0.5  # Site-level variance
# sigma_v_hosp <- runif(H, min = 0.3, max = 1)  # Varying sigma_v by hospital
sigma_v_hosp <- seq(0.4, 1,length.out = H)

# Exchangeable correlation structure
sigma_e <- 0.5  # Error variance
rho <- 0.5 # Correlation between outcomes
rho_mat <- matrix(rho, nrow = py, ncol = py)  # Exchangeable correlation matrix
diag(rho_mat) <- 1  # Diagonal elements are 1


# Generate data
nn <- rep(m_hosp, times = 1)  # Number of patients per hospital
id.hosp <- rep(1:H, times = m_hosp)  # Hospital ID
id.pat <- sequence(nn)  # Patient ID
n_visits <- sample(1:20, sum(nn), replace = TRUE)  # Number of visits per patient

# Expand hospital and patient IDs for visits
id.visit <- sequence(n_visits)
id.hosp.expanded <- rep(id.hosp, times = n_visits)
id.pat.expanded <- rep(id.pat, times = n_visits)

# Random effects
u_h <- rnorm(H, mean = 0, sd = sigma_u)  # Hospital effects
v_hi <- rnorm(sum(nn), mean = 0, sd = rep(sigma_v_hosp, times = m_hosp))  # Patient effects varying by hospital

# Expansion of hospital effects
u_h_patient <- rep(u_h, times = m_hosp)
u_h_expanded <- rep(u_h_patient, times = n_visits)

# Expansion of patient effects
v_hi_expanded <- rep(v_hi, times = n_visits)

# Covariates
X_bin <- matrix(rbinom(sum(n_visits) * p_bin, size = 1, prob = 0.3), nrow = sum(n_visits), ncol = p_bin)
X_cont <- matrix(rnorm(sum(n_visits) * p_cont, mean = 0, sd = 1), nrow = sum(n_visits), ncol = p_cont)
X_hij <- cbind(X_bin, X_cont)  # Combine binary & continuous covariates

# Generate multivariate errors with exchangeable correlation
epsilon_hij <- MASS::mvrnorm(sum(n_visits), mu = rep(0, py), 
                       Sigma = diag(sigma_e, py) %*% rho_mat %*% diag(sigma_e, py))

# Compute outcomes
Y_hij <- matrix(0, nrow = sum(n_visits), ncol = py)
for (k in 1:py) {
  Y_hij[, k] <- X_hij %*% beta[, k] + u_h_expanded + v_hi_expanded + epsilon_hij[, k]
}

# Create data table
three_lvl_dat <- data.table::data.table(
  site = id.hosp.expanded,
  patient = id.pat.expanded,
  visit = id.visit,
  X_hij, Y_hij
) %>% data.frame()

data.table::setnames(three_lvl_dat, c("site", "patient", "visit", paste0("X", 1:px), paste0("Y", 1:py)))

# Preprocessing
visit_count <- three_lvl_dat %>%
  dplyr::group_by(site, patient) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(total_visits = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Reorder data
rearranged_data <- merge(three_lvl_dat, visit_count, by = c("site", "patient")) %>%
  arrange(site, total_visits, patient) %>%
  mutate(site = factor(site))


# Introduce substantial missingness in Y_1 to Y_R
# rearranged_data_with_missing <- rearranged_data
# for(y_col in paste0("Y", 1:py)) {
#   missing_indices <- sample(1:nrow(rearranged_data), 
#                            size = round(nrow(rearranged_data) * missing_prob))
#   rearranged_data_with_missing[missing_indices, y_col] <- NA
# }

# Option 2: Different missingness patterns for each outcome
# rearranged_data_with_missing <- rearranged_data
# rearranged_data_with_missing$Y1[sample(1:nrow(rearranged_data), round(nrow(rearranged_data)*0.2))] <- NA
# rearranged_data_with_missing$Y2[sample(1:nrow(rearranged_data), round(nrow(rearranged_data)*0.3))] <- NA
# rearranged_data_with_missing$Y3[sample(1:nrow(rearranged_data), round(nrow(rearranged_data)*0.6))] <- NA

# Option 3: MAR
rearranged_data_with_missing <- rearranged_data
n <- nrow(rearranged_data)

# Step 1. Start with baseline missingness probabilities
p1_base <- 0.2   # baseline for Y1
p2_base <- 0.3   # baseline for Y2
p3_base <- 0.5   # baseline for Y3

# Step 2. For Y3: missingness depends on whether Y1 and Y2 are observed
# If both Y1 and Y2 are observed → Y3 more likely missing
Y3_miss_prob <- ifelse(!is.na(rearranged_data$Y1) & !is.na(rearranged_data$Y2), 
                       p3_base + 0.25,  # boost missingness
                       p3_base - 0.25)  # lower missingness
Y3_miss_prob <- pmin(pmax(Y3_miss_prob, 0), 1)
Y3_missing <- rbinom(n, 1, Y3_miss_prob) == 1
rearranged_data_with_missing$Y3[Y3_missing] <- NA

# Step 3. For Y1 and Y2: missingness depends on whether Y3 is observed
# If Y3 is observed → Y1/Y2 more likely missing
Y1_miss_prob <- ifelse(!is.na(rearranged_data_with_missing$Y3),
                       p1_base + 0.2, 
                       p1_base - 0.1)
Y2_miss_prob <- ifelse(!is.na(rearranged_data_with_missing$Y3),
                       p2_base + 0.2, 
                       p2_base - 0.1)
Y1_miss_prob <- pmin(pmax(Y1_miss_prob, 0), 1)
Y2_miss_prob <- pmin(pmax(Y2_miss_prob, 0), 1)

Y1_missing <- rbinom(n, 1, Y1_miss_prob) == 1
Y2_missing <- rbinom(n, 1, Y2_miss_prob) == 1

rearranged_data_with_missing$Y1[Y1_missing] <- NA
rearranged_data_with_missing$Y2[Y2_missing] <- NA


# Ensure no cases where all Ys are missing
all_y_missing <- apply(rearranged_data_with_missing[, paste0("Y", 1:py), drop = FALSE], 1, function(x) all(is.na(x)))
num_all_missing <- sum(all_y_missing)

if (num_all_missing > 0) {
  cat("Found", num_all_missing, "cases where all Ys are missing. Fixing...\n")
  
  # For each case where all Ys are missing, randomly select one Y to be observed
  for (i in which(all_y_missing)) {
    y_to_keep <- sample(paste0("Y", 1:py), 1)
    rearranged_data_with_missing[i, y_to_keep] <- rearranged_data[i, y_to_keep]
  }
}

# Check the missingness pattern
cat("Missingness summary:\n")
print(sapply(rearranged_data_with_missing[paste0("Y", 1:py)], function(x) mean(is.na(x))))

mice::md.pattern(rearranged_data_with_missing[,paste0("Y",1:py)])


# Verify no cases have all Ys missing
all_y_still_missing <- apply(rearranged_data_with_missing[, paste0("Y", 1:py), drop = FALSE], 1, function(x) all(is.na(x)))
cat("Number of cases with all Ys missing:", sum(all_y_still_missing), "\n")

# Check final dataset
cat("\nDataset dimensions:", dim(rearranged_data_with_missing), "\n")
cat("Complete cases:", sum(complete.cases(rearranged_data_with_missing)), "\n")
cat("Percentage complete cases:", round(mean(complete.cases(rearranged_data_with_missing)) * 100, 2), "%\n")


rearranged_data
rearranged_data_with_missing
rearranged_data_with_missing_cc <- cc(rearranged_data_with_missing)

sites <- unique(rearranged_data_with_missing$site)
imputed_datasets <- list()

for(site_id in sites) {
  site_data <- rearranged_data_with_missing[rearranged_data_with_missing$site == site_id, ]
  imp_site <- mice::mice(site_data, m = 1)
  imputed_datasets[[as.character(site_id)]] <- mice::complete(imp_site)
}

# Combine all site-specific imputed datasets
rearranged_data_with_missing_mice <- do.call(rbind, imputed_datasets)

rearranged_data_with_missing_mice_full <- complete(mice(rearranged_data_with_missing, m = 1)) # full-data imputed data
```



```{r full}
source("PEAL_Engine_Multi-RI.R")
# XYZ
Y <- as.matrix(rearranged_data[, paste0("Y", 1:py)])
X <- as.matrix(rearranged_data[, paste0("X", 1:px)])
X <- cbind(X)
Z <- list()

for(i in 1:H){
  count_mat = rearranged_data %>%
                    filter(site == i) %>%
                    group_by(site, patient) %>%
                    dplyr::summarise(n_hi = n(), .groups = 'drop')

  Z[[i]] <- (generate_Zhv_matrix(count_mat))
}

id.site <- rearranged_data$site

fit_mv_full <- peal.fit.RI_mv(
  Y = Y, X = X, Z = Z, id.site = id.site,
  weights = NULL, reml = TRUE,
  corstr = "exchangeable",        # or "independence"
  estimate_rho = TRUE, rho_init = 0.1,  # estimate residual correlation
  verbose = TRUE
)

fit_mv_ind_full <- peal.fit.RI_mv(
  Y = Y, X = X, Z = Z, id.site = id.site,
  weights = NULL, reml = TRUE,
  corstr = "independence",       
  estimate_rho = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)
```

```{r observed}
source("PEAL_Engine_Missing_Multi-RI3.R")

X_cols <- paste0("X", 1:px)
Y_cols <- paste0("Y", 1:py)


site_summary <- peal.get.summary_mv_patterns(
  data     = rearranged_data_with_missing,
  X_cols   = X_cols,
  Y_cols   = Y_cols,
  site_col = "site",
  patient_col = "patient"
)
# site_summary$`1`

fit_mv_missing <- peal.fit.RI_mv_patterns(
  data     = rearranged_data_with_missing,
  X_cols   = X_cols,
  Y_cols   = Y_cols,
  site_col = "site",
  patient_col = "patient",
  reml     = TRUE,
  corstr   = "exchangeable",   # or "independence" for a fast independence fit
  rho_init = 0.1,
  verbose  = TRUE
)

fit_mv_ind_missing <- peal.fit.RI_mv_patterns(
  data     = rearranged_data_with_missing,
  X_cols   = X_cols,
  Y_cols   = Y_cols,
  site_col = "site",
  patient_col = "patient",
  reml     = TRUE,
  corstr   = "independence",  
  rho_init = 0.1,
  verbose  = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
cbind(
"true" = c(sigma_u, sigma_v_hosp) ,
"full" = sqrt(fit_mv_full$theta * fit_mv_full$s2),
"ind_full" = sqrt(fit_mv_ind_full$theta * fit_mv_ind_full$s2),
"missing_cc" = sqrt(fit_mv_missing_cc$theta * fit_mv_missing_cc$s2),
"ind_missing_cc" = sqrt(fit_mv_ind_missing_cc$theta * fit_mv_ind_missing_cc$s2),
"missing_mice" = sqrt(fit_mv_missing_mice$theta * fit_mv_missing_mice$s2),
"ind_missing_mice" = sqrt(fit_mv_ind_missing_mice$theta * fit_mv_ind_missing_mice$s2),
"missing" = sqrt(fit_mv_missing$theta * fit_mv_missing$s2),
"ind_missing" = sqrt(fit_mv_ind_missing$theta * fit_mv_ind_missing$s2),
"em_missing" = sqrt(fit_missing_em$theta * fit_missing_em$history$init$s2),
"ind_em_missing" = sqrt(fit_missing_em_ind$theta * fit_missing_em_ind$history$init$s2)
)
```
